summary.zh: 预发布研究平台，采用有来源的收录快照
summary.en: Pre-release research platform using a sourced catalog snapshot

boundary.zh: 以下是项目验收记录，不是当前网站的实时健康状态。代码更新、本地验证与线上部署分别记录。
boundary.en: This is an acceptance record, not live site health. Code updates, local verification and deployment are tracked separately.

name.zh: 动态、知识库、家族与图谱

implemented.zh: 完整浏览、筛选和关联入口保留。
implemented.en: Browsing, filtering and linked navigation are retained.

verified.zh: 动态手机菜单、知识库查询、跨页对比已复验；保留无结果与组合筛选。页面内菜单替代手机原生长列表，未据此宣称全部业务场景通过。
verified.en: Mobile update menus, knowledge search and linked comparison were rechecked, including empty and combined filters. In-page menus replace long native mobile lists; this does not establish every business scenario.

implemented.zh: 登录、研究保存、修改、历史及报告导出。
implemented.en: Sign-in, research saving, revision, history and report export.

verified.zh: 保留原五场景，并复验新建、修改保存、原页澄清及旧版重开。文档问答的 516 字任务实际复制粘贴一致，Markdown/PDF 实际下载并逐页检查；任务框增至 12 行。私有部署原题的条件路线及官方权重、模型卡、许可入口已线上核对；目标硬件、整套应用的数据边界与业务效果仍需实测。
verified.en: The original five scenarios are retained. New research, saved revisions, same-page clarification and prior versions were rechecked. A 516-character task copied and pasted exactly; Markdown/PDF files were downloaded and visually inspected, and task boxes now show 12 rows. The original private-deployment task's conditional route and official weights, model card and license links were checked online. Target hardware, application data boundaries and business results remain untested.

implemented.zh: 事实与证据分离，原文、摘要和未分类文本区分。
implemented.en: Claims and evidence separated; quotations, summaries and unclassified text distinguished.

verified.zh: 历史 489 项来源比对记录保留；本轮新增 8 项逐条审核事实。原 7 条缺证关系现为 3 条范围核实、3 条有据推断、1 条待核实，原始 ID 保留；持续时效与独立复核尚未完成。
verified.en: The historical 489-record source comparison is retained, with eight individually reviewed facts added. Of the original seven unsupported relations, three have scoped verification, three are sourced inferences and one remains unverified. Original IDs are retained; ongoing freshness and independent review remain open.

implemented.zh: 采集、候选审核、发布与通知模块保留。
implemented.en: Collection, candidate review, publishing and notification modules retained.

verified.zh: 已有软件回归；持续更新闭环及邮件实际送达尚未验收。
verified.en: Software regressions tested; continuous update cycle and actual email delivery not yet accepted.

implemented.zh: README、使用说明、项目介绍和验证记录。
implemented.en: README, usage guides, project introduction and validation records.

verified.zh: 前后端从 main 自动发布，验收检查版本一致性，页面与文档共用进度。旧服务工作线程缓存应用 HTML 的恢复路径已修复，离线时显示独立说明页并保留原地址；不缓存登录态或研究正文。免费平台首次唤醒仍可能较慢。
verified.en: Frontend and backend deploy automatically from main, with release-consistency acceptance checks and shared page/document status. The stale service-worker HTML fallback was repaired: offline navigation shows a standalone page at the original URL without caching authentication or research content. Free-platform cold starts may remain slow.
